g.text: ESP32 DevKitC V4 • breadboard wiring for LED4 / buttons4
Two breadboards for clarity. Numbered columns: a–e and f–j are separate strips; rails must be common.
A=anode (long leg), K=cathode (short leg). Each LED has its own resistor.
Each switch bridges the center gap. Check actual contact pairs with continuity.
GPIO on one contact; the other contact to common GND. INPUT_PULLUP: pressed LOW.
Use a wiring table with the image. Real header positions can vary; follow GPIO silk-screen labels.
